What a swimmer runs into on the current page
  • The page’s whole Hours of Operation section is “Glassell pool is now Open, Heated.” The hours are only in a PDF.
  • That PDF closes the pool from October 22 to December 3. The page says nothing about it, and nothing is published for after December 3.
